fields.stepCount: Required whole number of at least 1: how many copies of each input row to make, one per scenario step.
fields.step_column: The 0-based step index column added to each copy; default "scenario_index".
fields.column_name: Optional value column added to each copy, spaced evenly from min_value (step 0) to max_value (the last step); set it with min_value and max_value.
fields.min_value / max_value: The first and last scenario values, such as 0.9 and 1.1 for a price factor from -10% to +10%.
fields.quote_id: The column that identifies each quote, for the optimiser downstream.
fields.steps: Optional post-processing step cards over the expanded frame; df is already bound, so there is no source step.

configs.name: minimal
configs.intent: Copy each quote five times with a step index.

configs.name: realistic
configs.intent: Test price factors from 0.9 to 1.1 in 21 steps and price each scenario.
